Subject: Implementation playbook & escalation path for Redwood → Helix integration

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — our engineering and services teams are lining up the Helix Connect adapter to Redwood's hosted API. We've started drafting an implementation playbook and want to align on two operational items before we onboard:

1) Formal escalation path and SLA expectations for partner-facing incidents (who owns what at each severity).
2) Where we should send diagnostics and the preferred channel for high-priority incidents (pager, email, Slack).

Attached is our initial playbook draft and a simple SLA matrix so you can see our presumptions. Can we lock a 30-min sync this week to finalize escalation contacts and handoff steps?

Attachments: [Attachment: helix-implementation-playbook-v1.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: helix-support-sla-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

Short answers up front:
- Escalation path: Redwood wants a primary + secondary contact from Helix for Sev1/Sev2. For Sev3 we can use ticketing + scheduled syncs.
- Channels: For Sev1 use PagerDuty (pager) + email; for Sev2 pager optional + email; Sev3 ticketing (Zendesk) is fine.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick sync — Tue 7/21 09:00am PT (I can send a calendar invite).
2) You send primary/secondary contact names/emails for each severity.
3) We'll provide a short on-call runbook and our escalation-contacts sheet that maps: issue class -> owner -> runbook link.

Thanks — reviewed the SLA matrix. A few technical notes and recommended edits: 

- Sev1 (production outage impacting >10% of requests): 15-min acknowledgment is fine; remediation ETA should be scoped with a short-term mitigation (failover to cached model / toggle connector) and a targeted 2-hour remediation window where possible.
- Sev2 (partial degradation): 1-hour acknowledgment; target remediation within 8 business hours.
- Sev3 (informational/low impact): tracked in Jira with SLA response in 48 hours.

Runbook/automations I will share:
- Canary rollout steps for connector (feature flagging + 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%)
- KV cache priming checklist and diagnostic script (link below).

Attachments I'm adding: helix-support-sla-matrix.xlsx (updated with our remediation windows)
Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Infra/Partner+Connector+Runbook

I'll join the sync and can present the canary plan. Marcus
